research.description: Research with the Crystal Relay researcher (read-only)
research.template:
Research this request without editing files. Return the relevant files, current behavior, impact analysis, risks, and a focused implementation plan with [must-have] tags.

$ARGUMENTS

implement.description: Implement with the Crystal Relay coder
implement.template:
Implement this focused request. Keep edits scoped, preserve existing patterns, run dotnet build, and confirm every [must-have] item.

$ARGUMENTS

verify.description: Debug and verify with the Crystal Relay debugger
verify.template:
Verify this work or failure. Run dotnet build, diagnose blockers grouped by root cause, fix major issues, and report deferred minor notes.

$ARGUMENTS

review.description: Final independent review with the Crystal Relay finalizer
review.template:
Independently review the current work against the original request. Verify every [must-have] item, run dotnet build. Return APPROVED, APPROVED_WITH_MINOR_NOTES, or RETURN_TO_CODER with a full structured report.

$ARGUMENTS
